snippet.title: Usual June Launch Date Announcement 👻🪦✨
snippet.description:
✨Usual June✨ is launching on October 28th, 2026! 

Plus, you can play the brand new demo right now on Steam.

Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

👻 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702430/Usual_June/
✨ Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702430/Usual_June/
👻 Join the Finji Discord: https://discord.com/invite/finji
